Two dozen spectator minifigures packed along the near grass, heads barely reaching the basket rim above them, every figure shorter than a single smooth-sided gas cylinder.
A crowd fifty deep massed to the left of the field only, each minifigure's helmet level with the chase-trailer's axle, one figure mid-fall off a brick picnic rug.
A school party of small minifigures in matching yellow caps strung out along the fence, every cap shorter than the trailer wheel hub, every C-hand pointing a different direction in the sky.
Families spread across the plate-mosaic grass on brick picnic rugs, a dog weaving between them trailing its lead, every seated figure shorter than the nearest basket rim above.
A marching band in red shakos bunched at one corner only, a brick tuba raised above the heads, every player's shako shorter than the burner frame behind them.
A gaggle of camera-holding minifigures crouched low at the near skirt, all of them shorter than the burner frame overhead, one figure flat on their front to get a lower shot.
Ground crew in orange overalls scattered across the field in ones and twos, each barely reaching a basket rim, one crewman sitting on a smooth-brick gas cylinder eating a brick sandwich.
A knot of would-be passengers bunched against one hedgerow only, every head level with a trailer axle, the figure at the very front holding a brick hamper with a chicken in it.
A crowd a hundred strong with a dozen small figures riding on shoulders above the rest, every rider's head still below the basket rim beside them.
A knot of minifigures pressing round a vendor's cart heaped with brick apples, all shorter than the cart's own wheel, one child mid-chase after a loose brick apple through their legs.
A huddle of flat-capped farmers leaning on one gate to the left only, cows jostling behind them, every farmer's cap shorter than the trailer's wheel hub beside the gate.
A crowd in brick winter hats massed to one side only, trans-white breath-plates puffing from every face, the shortest figure barely reaching the knee of the basket's wicker corner upright.
Nearly a hundred minifigures turned almost entirely away from the camera watching the sky, C-hands raised unevenly, every head level with a smooth-panelled gas cylinder beside them.
A scatter of minifigures lying flat on their backs on the plate-mosaic grass looking straight up, a dog weaving between them, every one of them shorter than the basket rim even standing.
A crowd of figures holding one another's hats on in the prop-wash of the burner, hats mid-flight across the scene, every head well below the burner frame above them.
Children mid-chase through the legs of a packed crowd after a loose brick ball, every running figure shorter than the trailer wheel hub beside the near rope.
A wedding party clustered to one side of the field, every figure in white or cream brick, the tallest still shorter than the smooth-panelled gas cylinder the ring-bearer is leaning on.
A brass-hatted mayoral minifigure standing on a brick crate above the heads of a crowd fifty strong, yet even the mayor's hat barely clears the basket rim behind him.
A crowd of a hundred with one tall brick ladder rising from the near left and three figures up the rungs, the topmost still below the load-tape clip above the basket.
A crowd of figures every one of whom is looking the wrong way, backs turned to the balloon, all gazing at a single brick pigeon on the fence, every head below a trailer axle.
Sixty minifigures in summer hats massed along the near grass to the left only, a vendor's smooth-walled cart heaped with brick ice creams at the edge, all figures shorter than the cart wheel.
A brass band crammed into one near corner, instruments raised unevenly above the heads, every player shorter than the burner frame, a trombone slide poking into the crowd behind.
A crowd of small figures in brick raincoats and hoods massed to the right of the near rope only, each one shorter than a gas cylinder, one figure's umbrella blown inside-out above the rest.
A hundred figures all pressing forward to the left of the basket, their collective C-hands outstretched, every head below the basket rim, a stray brick dog leading the charge at the front.
A scatter of figures lying face-down on the plate-mosaic grass, apparently napping, a dog sitting alertly among them, and every recumbent figure shorter than the wheel hub of the trailer behind them.
